clause_text: Company may terminate this agreement at any time without cause upon written notice to Contractor.
Either party may terminate this agreement for any reason with 30 days prior written notice.
Company reserves the right to terminate this agreement immediately and without notice if Contractor fails to meet performance benchmarks as solely determined by the Company.
Contractor shall not receive payment for services rendered until Company has received payment from the end client.
Company may withhold up to 20% of Contractor's earned compensation as a performance guarantee to be released at the Company's sole discretion.
Payment of final invoice shall be contingent upon Contractor completing a satisfactory exit interview and returning all Company property.
Contractor agrees not to engage in any competing business or employment within a 150-mile radius for a period of 24 months following termination.
For a period of 12 months after termination Contractor shall not solicit or accept work from any client of the Company or its affiliates worldwide.
Contractor shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business that is competitive with the Company during the term of this agreement and for 36 months thereafter.
Any dispute arising under this agreement shall be resolved exclusively through binding arbitration administered by a provider selected by the Company.
Contractor waives all rights to participate in class action proceedings and agrees that all claims shall be arbitrated on an individual basis only.
source_citation: Epic Systems Corp. v. Lewis 584 U.S. 497

clause_text: All disputes shall be submitted to final and binding arbitration in a jurisdiction chosen by the Company with each party bearing its own costs.
Company shall own all intellectual property and work product created by Contractor during the term of this agreement including any work created outside normal working hours.
Contractor agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Company against any and all claims liabilities and expenses without limitation arising from Contractor's performance of services.
This agreement shall be governed by the laws of a jurisdiction selected by the Company at its sole discretion and Contractor consents to exclusive jurisdiction therein.
source_citation: Carnival Cruise Lines v. Shute 499 U.S. 585
